paite: Himahleh lunglau a om khinnu a ding in nguina himhim a-omta kei ding. Tunung Kumpipa Ding Nidanglai in Zebulun gam leh Naphtali gam simmohhuai in a-omsak a, himahleh hun nanung ah zaw thupitak in a-omsakta, tuipi gei, Jordan gal ah, namte' Galili mah.
english: But there shall be no more gloom for her who was in anguish. In the former time, he brought into contempt the land of Zebulun and the land of Naphtali; but in the latter time he has made it glorious, by the way of the sea, beyond the Jordan, Galilee of the nations.

paite: Mi mial nuai a vakte'n vak thupitak amuta ua; sihna lim gam a omte tung mahmah ah vak ahong vakta hi.
english: The people who walked in darkness have seen a great light. Those who lived in the land of the shadow of death, on them the light has shined.

paite: Nam na pungsakta a, anopsakna uh na khangsakta hi; buhlak lai a nuamsa bang in na ma ah nuam asata ua, min gallak sum ahawm ua nuam asak bang mai un.
english: You have multiplied the nation. You have increased their joy. They rejoice before you according to the joy in harvest, as men rejoice when they divide the spoil.

paite: Apuakgik puakna hakkol leh aliangzang a zawnna zawl, amah nuaisiahte khetbuk mah, Midiante zoh ni bang in na suktansakta ngala.
english: For the yoke of his burden, and the staff of his shoulder, the rod of his oppressor, you have broken as in the day of Midian.

paite: Chiak vengvung a mi galthuam a akithuamna tengteng uleh puansilh sisan toh kidiah niaunuau tengteng, hal a, mei a khul ding phet ahi ngal a.
english: For all the armor of the armed man in the noisy battle, and the garments rolled in blood, will be for burning, fuel for the fire.

paite: Ei ding in naupang ahong piang a, tapa piak in i omta; vaihawmna aliangzang ah atuang ding a; amin Lamdang, Lemthei, Pathian Hat, Tangtawn Pa, Lemna Lal lah achi sin ngal ua.
english: For to us a child is born. To us a son is given; and the government will be on his shoulders. His name will be called Wonderful, Counselor, Mighty God, Everlasting Father, Prince of Peace.

paite: David tutphah tung ah leh agam tung ah avaihawmna khandan leh lemna in tawp ni anei kei ding, hihkip ding leh tua kipan a tangtawn tan a leng vaihawmna leh diktatna tungding ding in, Sepaihte' TOUPA phatuamngaihna in huaite ahih ding.
english: Of the increase of his government and of peace there shall be no end, on the throne of David, and on his kingdom, to establish it, and to uphold it with justice and with righteousness from that time on, even forever. The zeal of Yahweh of Armies will perform this.

paite: Toupa'n Jakobte gam ah thu akhak a, Israelte tung ah aketa.
heading: TOUPA'N Israel Asawi Ding
english: The Lord sent a word into Jacob, and it falls on Israel.

paite: Huchi in mi tengteng, Ephraimte leh Samaria a om, kisatheitak leh lungsim a ki-uangsak;
english: All the people will know, including Ephraim and the inhabitants of Samaria, who say in pride and in arrogance of heart,

paite: tekleite chim mahleh, suang tak sek in i lemna ding; theipi singte sattan in om mahleh, sidar singte in i kheng ding, chite'n athei ding uh.
english: “The bricks have fallen, but we will build with cut stone. The sycamore fig trees have been cut down, but we will put cedars in their place.”

paite: Huaiziak in TOUPA'N Rezin dou mite amah dou ding in atawisang ding a;
english: Therefore Yahweh will set up on high against him the adversaries of Rezin, and will stir up his enemies,

paite: amelma, suahlam a Siriate, tumlam a Philistiate, atokthou ding; huchi in kam ka in Israelte ane khin ding uh. Huchi hial ahih in leng ahehna adai kei a, akhut alik lailai hi.
english: The Syrians in front, and the Philistines behind; and they will devour Israel with open mouth. For all this, his anger is not turned away, but his hand is stretched out still.

paite: Himahleh mite'n amaute vopa lam anga tuan kei ua, Sepaihte' TOUPA lah azong tuan kei uhi.
english: Yet the people have not turned to him who struck them, neither have they sought Yahweh of Armies.

paite: Huaiziak in TOUPA'N Israelte a kipan in alutang leh amei, tum hiang leh pumpeng ni khat thu in abantan ding.
english: Therefore Yahweh will cut off from Israel head and tail, palm branch and reed, in one day.

paite: Upa leh mizahtakhuaite, alutang ahi ua; zuauthu sinsak zawlneite, amei ahi uh.
english: The elder and the honorable man is the head, and the prophet who teaches lies is the tail.

paite: Hiai mipite'n apikhial nak uhi, apite uh hihmanthat in a-om nak uhi.
english: For those who lead this people lead them astray; and those who are led by them are destroyed.

paite: Huaiziak in TOUPA'N atangvalte uh tung ah akipak kei ding a, atagahte uleh ameithaite uh leng azahngai sam kei ding ua; avek un Pathian zahloumi leh thil hoih lou hih mite ahi chiat ua, akam un thugina lou agen uhi. Hichi ahih nung in leng, ahehna adai kei a, akhut alik lailai hi.
english: Therefore the Lord will not rejoice over their young men, neither will he have compassion on their fatherless and widows; for everyone is profane and an evildoer, and every mouth speaks folly. For all this his anger is not turned away, but his hand is stretched out still.

paite: Gitlouhna lah mei bang in akuang luahluah a, loulingnei leh khaulingneite akangmang ahi, gammang nong lak akang luahluah a, akhutou ngoingoi hi.
english: For wickedness burns like a fire. It devours the briers and thorns; yes, it kindles in the thickets of the forest, and they roll upward in a column of smoke.

paite: Sepaihte' TOUPA heh ziak in gam akangsia a, mite leng mei a khul ding sing bang ahi ua; kuamah in amau unau leng ahawi kei uhi.
english: Through the wrath of Yahweh of Armies, the land is burnt up; and the people are the fuel for the fire. No one spares his brother.

paite: Huchi in mi'n ataklam ua mi asuh ding ua, himahleh atai tuan kei ding uh; michih in amau bansa ane chiat ding uh.
english: One will devour on the right hand, and be hungry; and he will eat on the left hand, and they will not be satisfied. Everyone will eat the flesh of his own arm:

paite: Manassehte'n Ephraimte ane ding ua, Ephraimte'n Manassehte ane ding ua; anih un Judahte adoukhawm ding uhi. Huchi lawmlawm a ahih in leng, ahehna lah adai kei a, akhut alik lailai hi.
english: Manasseh, Ephraim; and Ephraim, Manasseh; and they together shall be against Judah. For all this his anger is not turned away, but his hand is stretched out still.
